{{Quote|Take this powder and put it into the Phlogs' food while they are sleeping. When they eat it, they will forget everything they have seen on this side of Endor&mdash;including the trees.|Logray, to Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Wicket Wystri Warrick|<ref name="How" />}}
'''Logray's magic powder''' was a [[Color/Legends|white]] powder created by the old [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor's]] [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. When the young Ewoks [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] told Logray about having encountered a pair of [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]]&mdash;giants considered by some Ewoks to be a threat to their way of life&mdash;the latter gave them two sacks containing the [[Magic/Legends|magic]] powder, claiming that putting it into the Phlogs' [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] would lead them to forgetting about their visit to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and instead becoming fearful of staying there or ever returning.

Although Kintaka and Warrick did not manage to put the powder into the giants' food, after being captured they did throw it into the Phlogs' faces, which eventually caused them to fall into deep [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. When the giants&mdash;who in the meantime were tied up by an Ewok scouting party&mdash;later awakened, they were initially confused and then became frightened of their surroundings, ultimately running off into the forest while yelling in panic.

==Description==
{{Quote|Instead, they will believe that this is an enchanted place, full of danger to all the Phlogs. They will leave, vowing never to return.|Logray, on the magic powder's effect on the Phlogs|<ref name="How" />}}
Logray's magic powder was a fine [[Color/Legends|white]]-colored powder created by [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], an old [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who would later become the [[Shaman/Legends|medicine man]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on<ref name="How" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> According to Logray, once [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]]<ref name="How" />&mdash;members of a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giants that was believed to have originated off-world<ref name="Castaways">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref> and whom some Ewoks considered to be a threat to their way of life&mdash;[[Diet/Legends|ate]] the powder, they would lose all memories of their visit to the side of Endor housing the Ewoks' [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and would instead become convinced that the forest was "[[Magic/Legends|enchanted]]" and dangerous to Phlogs, and they would thereafter leave and never return.<ref name="How" />

==History==
===A risky plan===
{{Quote|Princess! We've got to act fast before they eat us for breakfast! When I count to three, we'll throw our powder into their faces. Ready? One&hellip; two&hellip; three!|Wicket Wystri Warrick, to Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|<ref name="How" />}}
[[File:OldManGivesKidsDrugs-HowTheEwoksSavedTheTree.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Logray gives Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Wicket Wystri Warrick sacks containing the magic powder.]]
One [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="How" /> at some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[How the Ewoks Saved the Trees: An Old Ewok Legend]]'' is set before [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] has become [[Shaman/Legends|medicine man]]. Furthermore, ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of which Logray is already medicine [[Gender/Legends|man]], to between [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the young Ewoks [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] relayed to Logray in his [[Logray's hut|hut]] their discovery in the Ewoks' forest of two Phlogs. Believing that the plan of the Bright Tree Village's [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] to send a scouting party on the following day's morning to verify the news about the Phlogs would be too late to be of any practical use, Logray gave Kintaka and Warrick each a small sack with the powder and instructed the young Ewoks to put the substance into the [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] giants' [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Before Kintaka and Warrick could depart their village for the location where they had encountered the Phlogs, however, they were spotted by [[Shodu Warrick|Warrick's mother]] and forced to go home&mdash;although the young Ewoks agreed to proceed with their plan early on the following morning. Warrick also warned Kintaka not to let her father, Chirpa, notice her sack of the magic powder.<ref name="How" />

The next day, Kintaka and Warrick went to where the two Phlogs were sleeping, but before they could put the powder into the giants' food, they inadvertently awakened the Phlogs and were soon captured. While the giants held the small Ewoks in their [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and curiously inspected them, Warrick instructed his friend to empty the contents of their respective powder sacks into the faces of their captors before they could eat the Ewoks. On the count of three, the [[Gender/Legends|princess]] and her companion threw the magic powder into the faces of the Phlogs.<ref name="How" />

Initially, the two Phlogs simply looked startled, and nothing else happened. They both then sneezed once and began attempting to rub the powder off their faces, dropping the two Ewoks to the ground in the process. Consequently, adopting an expression of utter confusion, the giants ceased moving and, after a moment, slowly crumpled to the ground and entered a state of deep sleep. At that point, Kintaka and Warrick, wanting to believe that Logray's magic powder had worked but simply being too frightened at the [[Time/Legends|time]] to believe anything, ran away and hid themselves in the forest.<ref name="How" />

===Awakening and terror===
{{Quote|A strange and evil land! We must hurry home and never return!|translated=1|The two Phlogs, under the influence of Logray's magic powder|<ref name="How" />}}
[[File:PhlogsRunAway-HowTheEwoksSavedTheTree.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Phlogs run off into the Ewoks' forest after being exposed to Logray's magic powder.]]
There, Kintaka and Warrick encountered the Ewok scouting party, with the princess then explaining to them her and Warrick's plan. Although the Ewok [[Lumat/Legends|Lumat]] expressed doubt over the magic powder's effectiveness&mdash;pointing out both Logray's reputation of being "strange" and the possibility that the old Ewok had merely told the pair a made-up story in order to make them leave him alone&mdash;Warrick professed his confidence that the powder would work. The Ewoks then tied up the sleeping Phlogs.<ref name="How" />

The two giants eventually woke up, appearing confused at their whereabouts and tied-up state. After they effortlessly broke through their restraints, however, the two Phlogs adopted an aspect of fear. Pointing wildly at the surrounding [[Tree/Legends|trees]], the giants staggered to their feet and, oblivious to the nearby Ewoks, turned and ran off into the woods as if they were being pursued by [[Demon/Legends|demons]], yelling about the land they were in being "strange and evil" and expressing their urgent need to return [[Desert of Simoom|home]]. Later that night at the Bright Tree Village, during the Ewok celebration over driving away the Phlogs, Logray was named the settlement's medicine man for the role his magic powder had played in that event.<ref name="How" />

==Behind the scenes==
Logray's magic powder appeared in ''[[How the Ewoks Saved the Trees: An Old Ewok Legend]]'', a [[1984]] young reader book written by [[James Howe]] and illustrated by [[Walter Velez]].<ref name="How" />
